19069.title: Lansdowne
19069.extract:
There is more than one place with the name Lansdowne, you may be looking for:


Canada
Lansdowne (Ontario) — is part of Leeds and the 1000 Islands, between Gananoque and Brockville. See also Thousand Islands.
Landsdowne House is a remote (pop 300) native reservation in northern Ontario reachable only by ice road or bush plane.


India
Lansdowne (India) — a town in Uttarakhand


United States of America
Lansdowne (Pennsylvania) — a town in Pennsylvania
Lansdowne (Virginia) — a town in Virginia
